changelog: 1.4.1: fixed Mail.ru connecting with HTTP 409 (the document server's nginx needs an Accept-Language header; the User-Agent now follows browser releases and rotates after a refusal; outgoing data is no longer deflated twice); loss detection stays at its defaults except for MTS, Boards and Telemost, which restores Mail.ru and Yandex Docs speed; the tunnel is tuned per transport; Cups: faster cursor codec, bounded send queue, connect gate, the exit publishes its room list; Telemost reports its connection state so the host leaves the setup status; transport code resynced with the current openflux-server. 1.4.0: Telemost (Yandex Telemost, striped WebRTC lanes) and Cups (cups.online) transports, links openflux://telemost?url=... and openflux://cupsonline?url=<room list>; every HTTP, WebSocket and WebRTC socket of the new transports is protected from the VPN and they reconnect on a network change; token-keyed end-to-end encryption taken from the link; Boards batches no longer lost silently, plus the current Boards/MTS/Mail.ru/Yandex fixes; Yandex check window opens after the in-module PoW fails, with a manual-cookies setting; transport code resynced with the current openflux-server. 1.1.3: Yandex transport now sends a bare, less conspicuous User-Agent that avoids triggering most of Yandex's bot-check CAPTCHAs in the first place; when one still gets through, the module waits much longer before retrying instead of hammering the same block on the normal fast schedule. 1.1.2: fixed a leaked socket + goroutine on every transport Stop() (a blocked read could keep a dead connection alive for up to a minute, and a handshake finishing after Stop() went live with nothing left to read it) - also fixes a node-wide connection-tracking leak on the exit-node side. 1.1.1: DNS resolver now refreshes from a new 'dns' host event instead of only at startup, so lookups stop timing out against a stale server list after roaming to a new network; socks5Udp explicitly declared false so hosts stop routing UDP/QUIC into this module; added pingWhileConnected; server-side transport/network code resynced with the current openflux-server fork.
